method: Preserved the existing detailed local-coordinate model; this dedicated builder verifies its GIS ring, records an official Purdue building-specific exterior photograph, maps visible photo cues to model object groups, and separates preview-only cameras/light from the exported collection. It does not infer dimensions from a perspective image.

gis_source.provider: Purdue University official campus map / BuildingShapes ArcGIS FeatureServer
gis_source.name: Benjamin Harrison Residence Hall
gis_source.source_crs: Purdue ArcGIS service native EPSG:3857; returned snapshot geometry EPSG:4326
gis_source.measurement: 28-point exterior ring; transformed using the project's local meters-per-degree approximation, then subtracting manifest placement origin [-1110,-260] m. Symmetric nearest-vertex error against the preserved HARR_Ground_Plinth_Base perimeter is recorded below.
gis_source.limits: Official campus map footprint is not a certified survey and does not verify facade or vertical dimensions.

architectural_sources.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
architectural_sources.supports: Three major wings; north and south wings are 8 stories; center section is 2 stories.
architectural_sources.uncertainty: No total height, roof elevation/form, or floor-to-floor measurements.

architectural_sources.supports: Opened in 1966; two wings connected by central common areas; address 107 MacArthur Drive.
architectural_sources.uncertainty: Residence page is not an elevation or dimensional source.

architectural_sources.source_date: February 2024 Harrison Hall award entry; page last modified 2026-04-20
architectural_sources.supports: Official page identifies an image taken outside the Harrison Hall entrance.
architectural_sources.uncertainty: The image is not a measured facade elevation.

architectural_sources.source_date: No publication date for the page hero image; page checked 2026-10-25.
architectural_sources.source_image_caption: Harrison Hall exterior (official page hero image); capture date and viewpoint orientation not stated.
architectural_sources.supports: Building-specific exterior image visibly shows red-brown brick on tall wings and lower connector, repeated vertically stacked narrow windows, a light-colored perforated screen across the lower connector, and a glazed entrance adjoining a broad light canopy/overhang.
architectural_sources.uncertainty: Perspective photograph supports visible material and composition cues only; it provides no facade dimensions, screen dimensions, compass orientation, or evidence for unpictured elevations.

facade_photo_comparison.status: Photo-backed visual cues; no dimensions extracted from perspective image.
facade_photo_comparison.viewpoint_registration: The Purdue page does not state the photograph's compass direction. Compare motifs only; the mapping to the model's west view is visual, not georeferenced.

observed_cues_and_model_objects.photo_cue: Red-brown brick on the tall wings and lower connector.
Repeated narrow windows stacked vertically on a tall wing.
observed_cues_and_model_objects.status: Repeated window rhythm is visible; exact spacing remains schematic, and photo-to-wing orientation is not established.

observed_cues_and_model_objects.photo_cue: Light perforated screen across the lower connector.
observed_cues_and_model_objects.status: Screen presence and contrast supported; exact dimensions/pattern and solar-control function remain unverified.

observed_cues_and_model_objects.photo_cue: Glazed entrance adjoining a broad, light canopy/overhang.
observed_cues_and_model_objects.status: Composition supported; exact proportions remain schematic.

not_established_by_photo: Exact window width, spacing, and frame profile.
Perforated screen dimensions, precise block pattern, and solar-control function.
Canopy dimensions, roof construction, parapets, and rooftop equipment.
The modeled HARRISON HALL lettering and its location.
Facade treatments on elevations not visible in this photograph.
facade_photo_comparison.reason_no_facade_geometry_change: The rendered entrance elevation already expresses the visible photo-supported cues. A perspective photograph cannot establish dimensions or justify moving facade elements, so unmeasured details remain schematic instead of being guessed.

placement.local_frame: meters; X east, Y north, Z up

vertical_status.height: Unverified. The official OEP plan supports relative story arrangement only: 8 stories each in north/south wings; 2 stories in the central section.
vertical_status.roof: Unverified; no roof form or elevation found in the consulted Purdue sources.
vertical_status.floor_to_floor: Unverified; no authoritative vertical measurements found.
vertical_status.interpretation: Do not treat modeled z values or GIS NUM_LEVELS as surveyed total building height or precise floor datums.

export_validation.geometry_note: Retained existing detailed geometry because its GIS perimeter and three-wing massing agree with official Purdue sources and its entrance view expresses the photo-backed brick, stacked-window, lower-screen, and entrance/canopy cues. No photo-derived dimensions or unsupported facade edits were made.

remaining_uncertainty: No authoritative total building height, roof geometry, or floor-to-floor dimensions were located.
Exact window spacing, west screen dimensions/pattern/function, entrance proportions, and unpictured elevations remain unverified; the photo is perspective, not an elevation.
The official GIS polygon supports identity and horizontal plan geometry but is not a survey.
